# Tailrocks: Skill Audit

`tailrocks-skill-audit` — part of [tailrocks-skills](../../README.md) · [documentation](https://skills.tailrocks.com/docs/skills/tailrocks-skill-audit)

Audit one skill or every skill in the repository against the authoring doctrine. Read-only: reports defects by layer — description, router, references, evals, wiring, overlap — each with a stable finding ID and its named fix. Never edits.

## Invocation

This skill never activates on its own. Name it in your request:

> Use `tailrocks-skill-audit` …

Arguments: `<skill name>|all`
